turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
And how was that for you?
Tom and I argued about money, because his night shift pay is not enough with only my maternity pay.
How did that feel for you?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. Yes, it was like that.
What went through your mind then?
Having Mum here gave me my first full night of sleep in five months.
Take your time.
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. It is not easy to talk about.
How did that feel for you?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
How did that feel for you?
I am supposed to go back to school in September and the thought makes my stomach turn.
What went through your mind then?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. It is not easy to talk about.
And how was that for you?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
What happened next?
The stair thought comes less often now, maybe twice this week.
And how was that for you?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I keep coming back to it.
Tell me more about that.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
Let us stop here for today.
Thank you, see you next week.
